subject: maths
question: A cricketer has an average of 97 runs over 6 innings. If he scores 231 runs in the 7th inning, by how many runs (rounded off to the nearest whole number) does his average score increase?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial total = 97 × 6 = 582

New total = 582 + 231 = 813

New average = 813 ÷ 7 ≈ 116.14

Increase = 116.14 − 97 ≈ 19.14 ≈ 19

**∴ Answer = 19 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 6 innings = 97

Runs in 7th inning = 231

**Formula used:**

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 97 × 6 = 582

⇒ Total runs in 7 innings = 582 + 231 = 813

⇒ New average = 813 ÷ 7 = 116.14

⇒ Increase in average = 116.14 − 97 = 19.14

⇒ Rounded off increase = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number of observations

Total from Average

Total = Average × Count

Increment Concept

New average depends on total increase and number of observations

Rounding Rule

Round to nearest whole number as required
